parsed.name: 电子秤后端抽象模块
parsed.description: 用于实验室电子秤集成的非物理软件组件，定义清零、去皮和读取重量等通用控制接口，供上层实验自动化系统与具体电子秤实现对接。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component for laboratory scale integration. It defines common control interfaces such as zeroing, taring, and reading weight, allowing higher-level lab automation software to interact with concrete scale implementations.

actions.description: 向已连接的电子秤发送清零指令。
actions.description_en: Send a zero command to the connected scale.

actions.description: 向已连接的电子秤发送去皮指令。
actions.description_en: Send a tare command to the connected scale.

actions.description: 读取电子秤当前重量，单位为克。
actions.description_en: Read the current weight from the scale in grams.

actions.description: 通过兼容旧接口读取电子秤当前重量，单位为克。
actions.description_en: Read the current weight from the scale in grams through a deprecated compatibility method.
